summary.text: Matthew Gambill was elected to the Georgia House of Representatives in 2018 and represents House District 15 in Bartow County.

paragraphs.text: He is a lifelong Bartow County resident, a graduate of Cartersville High School, and holds a degree in Political Science from Lee University.
He is business development manager for Parrish Construction Group and previously served over 14 years as executive director of the Georgia Association for Career & Technical Education.
